acceptanceCriteria: Either `script/release-checklist` exposes a pre-promotion mode whose exit status reflects only the rows a candidate can satisfy before promotion (with the promotion-dependent rows reported as PENDING, not FAIL), or the `release-checklist` required gate is removed from the release records and the reason is recorded in the checklist spec.
`corvint-tasks release readiness` on a candidate with all other gates attested reports the checklist state truthfully.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 while preparing the v0-6 and v0-7 candidates (decision 0373). All six required gates must be attested for readiness, but `script/release-checklist` reports rows that only a promoted tag can satisfy, so its non-zero exit before promotion is structural: a candidate can never reach a readable READY state and the attestation would have to be recorded against a failing command.
title: release-checklist: the gate cannot exit 0 before promotion, so readiness records a structural non-zero for every candidate
